description: Portable tool schemas for trusted wrappers. Hosts should inject tenant/scope and authentication from policy where possible.

functions.name: mimicrag_retrieve
functions.description: Retrieve ranked evidence passages without generating an answer.

functions.name: mimicrag_expand
functions.description: Expand bounded document-graph neighbors from a retrieved node.

functions.name: mimicrag_ingest
functions.description: Ingest approved text. Expose only behind a host approval boundary.

functions.name: mimicrag_trace
functions.description: Inspect one retrieval or answer trace by identifier.

functions.name: mimicrag_memory_recall
functions.description: Recall active purpose-authorized memories owned by the authenticated identity.

functions.name: mimicrag_evidence_append
functions.description: Append an observed authoritative evidence event before forming memory.

functions.name: mimicrag_memory_remember
functions.description: Store memory linked to authoritative evidence only after an explicit user request; sensitive records require separate confirmation.

functions.name: mimicrag_memory_inspect
functions.description: Inspect one memory owned by the authenticated identity.

functions.name: mimicrag_retrieve_combined
functions.description: Retrieve separate authoritative-document and lower-trust memory tiers.
